messages:
aline (DevEx): quick heads-up: example in /examples/next-edge is throwing at runtime: "ReferenceError: require is not defined" when deployed to Vercel Edge.

 tom (SDK): That usually means the example is using CJS require. Can you paste the import section?

 aline (DevEx): yep: ```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = Redwood.createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```

 ravi (edge): Edge runtimes are strict ESM. We publish an edge-specific ESM entrypoint to avoid node polyfills. Use `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference/edge'` instead.

 tom (SDK): Also note TS folks hit confusing typings if they default-import. Recommend: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'` or `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference/edge'` for edge. We'll update README with explicit CJS vs ESM examples.

 kai (docs): I'll change the quickstart snippets to show both variants and call out env var names. Found a mismatch: sample uses REDWOOD_API_KEY but other guide had REDWOOD_KEY. Fixing now.

 ci-bot: failing test quickstart-next-edge  runtime error and 401 due to missing env. Logs: https://ci.example/quickstart/5678

 aline (DevEx): thanks. Also adding a note about retry defaults for edge: 3 retries for idempotent endpoints, 0 for generation by default. Adding snippet to docs.

 tom (SDK): Good. For bundlers also add webpack/mainFields note so module resolves to ESM in edge mode.

 kai (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/799. Will ping when merged.

 aline (DevEx): perfect, will re-run CI after merge. :party:
